name: longevity-os
description: Seth's personal training brain — decides today's session from Oura, time, location, and history.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@longevity/engine && npm run build --workspace=@longevity/web
scripts.check: npm run check:contracts && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run check:data && npm run check:kot-sql
scripts.sql:bundle:
bash -c '{ head -19 supabase/SCHEMA_ALL_IN_ONE.sql; for f in supabase/migrations/*.sql; do printf "
-- == %s ==

" "$(basename $f)"; cat "$f"; done; } > /tmp/b.sql && mv /tmp/b.sql supabase/SCHEMA_ALL_IN_ONE.sql'
